tools.name: start_audit
tools.description: Create a stored SEO/AEO audit of a public business website without an account or data connection. Accepts optional dated provider reports. Reads the homepage, up to four internal pages, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and up to five relevant competitor websites discovered from public market research or supp

tools.name: check_audit
tools.description: Where a Website SEO/AEO audit stands. When it is ready, the full result as text and a link to it on Findable's site.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_audit · Private data: start_audit · Public sink: start_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_audit · Private data: start_audit · Public sink: start_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
